output.rationale: The study investigates the association between PM2.5 and respiratory hospitalizations in South Korea using time-series analysis.

The study is an original epidemiological study investigating the association between PM2.5 exposure and respiratory hospitalization (asthma exacerbations), using a time-series design and reporting a quantitative effect estimate.

The study meets all inclusion criteria: it is an original epidemiological study, the exposure is PM2.5, the outcome is respiratory hospitalization, the study design is case-crossover, and a quantitative effect estimate with confidence interval is reported.
The study is an original epidemiological study (time-stratified case-crossover) that investigates the association between PM2.5 exposure and respiratory hospitalizations/ED visits in children.

The study is an original epidemiological study that meets all the inclusion criteria: it investigates PM2.5 exposure, respiratory hospitalization as an outcome, uses a time-stratified case-crossover design, reports a relative risk (or equivalent effect measure), and is published in English.
